hole.registration: same features and S; all 8 CAD values registered; class-c doors identified, other-class decisions, relative residual, margin utilisation

D_unseen_all_folds.reporting: Per fold and pooled over the five folds (fold 0 = seed 42): unregistered doors rejected out of 361 and per class, registered-door decisions correct / rejected / wrong out of 2,527, image AUROC mean and minimum over the 40 runs, smallest distance of an unregistered image to a registered CAD value; for the hole method the doors identified after CAD registration out of 361 (Wilson 95%), other-class decisions and the largest margin utilisation. Every failure is listed with class, fold, door and distance.
D_unseen_all_folds.claim_rule: All folds, both CNNs and all four scores are reported whatever the direction. 'All rejected' or 'all identified' is stated only if it holds in every fold; otherwise the counts are given and the failures are described next to the rejection margin (C1). The CNN scores and thresholds are not changed.

C1_rejection_margin.definition: For an unseen-class run (class c removed): a = largest |D - CAD of the true class| over the measured TEST images of the registered classes (S and CAD list without c); b = smallest distance of a measured TEST image of class c to the nearest registered CAD value. Any reject distance tau with a <= tau < b rejects no registered image by distance and rejects every measured unregistered image.
C1_rejection_margin.report: a, b and the number of unmeasured images per run; over runs: largest a and smallest b, for the three fold-0 seeds and for the five folds (seed 42). Per class: nominal rejection margin = (distance from the CAD value of c to the nearest other CAD value) - 30 mm, observed rejection margin = b - 30 mm. tau stays 30 mm; this is a sensitivity description, not a new operating point.

C2_door_level_operating_points.door_score: CNN: largest image score of the door (for each of the four scores). Hole: minus the smallest image distance to a registered CAD value (images without a measurement do not count). With the session vote of the manuscript a door is rejected exactly when all its images are rejected, so thresholding the image scores at t accepts a door exactly when its door score is >= t.
C2_door_level_operating_points.validation_door_threshold: per run and score: t_val = smallest door score over the validation doors of the run's registered classes (the strictest threshold that still accepts every validation door). Hole: tau_val = largest over validation doors of the smallest image distance. The TEST images are thresholded at t_val and the doors are judged by the usual vote. Hole validation features are extracted for this (inference only), for the 24 fold-0 runs and the 32 new runs.
C2_door_level_operating_points.posthoc_operating_point: t_test = smallest door score over the registered TEST doors of the run (no registered door rejected); unregistered doors rejected at t_test. This is fitted on the TEST data and is reported as a reference, not as a selection procedure.
C2_door_level_operating_points.door_auroc: per run: P(score of a registered door > score of an unregistered door) + 0.5 P(tie), over TEST doors; mean and minimum over runs
C2_door_level_operating_points.uncertainty: the registered-door decisions repeat each door in seven runs; the number of distinct doors rejected at least once as a registered door is reported, and a 95% percentile interval of the pooled registered-decision rejection rate from 2,000 bootstrap resamples of the distinct TEST doors (numpy default_rng(20261112))
C2_door_level_operating_points.report: for the hole method and for every CNN score: unregistered doors rejected and registered decisions rejected / wrong at (i) the manuscript's operating point (hole 30 mm, CNN image threshold), (ii) the validation-door threshold, (iii) the post-hoc point; door AUROC; distinct doors; for fold 0 (three seeds) and for the five folds (seed 42).
